one_liner: Self-hostable no-code internal tools on top of your Postgres — schema in, working admin panel out.
description: stackbuilt connects to an existing Postgres database, reads the schema, and scaffolds CRUD interfaces, dashboards, and approval flows in under a minute. It self-hosts with a single Docker command so data never leaves your network, includes role-based access control in the free tier, and charges per builder — viewers are always free.
target_user: Engineers who keep getting asked to build one more admin panel

icp.who: Backend engineers and eng leads at 20-500 person companies with a growing pile of internal tool requests
icp.pain: Retool pricing scales per user until it hurts, and compliance teams balk at piping production data through someone else's cloud
icp.buying_trigger: A Retool renewal quote, or a security review that rules out cloud-hosted internal tools touching production data

differentiators: Single-command Docker self-hosting — production data never leaves your network
Reads your Postgres schema and scaffolds a working CRUD UI in under a minute
Viewers are free forever; only builders pay
proof_points: Schema-to-working-UI in under 60 seconds, shown unedited in the demo video
Runs in production at a 200-person logistics company
RBAC included in the free self-hosted tier
pricing_current: free self-hosted; cloud at $25/builder/month with unlimited free viewers

voice.sample_phrase: Point it at Postgres. Ship the admin panel before standup ends.

signals: Public beta, Docker image on Docker Hub
Named production deployment referenced on site

gaps: Postgres-only; no MySQL or REST sources yet
Documentation covers setup but few advanced guides

confidence.notes: Core workflow is verifiable from the demo. Enterprise-readiness claims are early-stage.
